item.title: Global energy crisis: Asia feels the squeeze
item.summary: Asian nations, including India, are feeling the impact of the ongoing war in Iran. We explore how dependent the region is on West Asia for energy and consider whether New Delhi should position itself as a mediator to help bring the conflict to an end.

item.title: United States: Attack on a Michigan synagogue and deadly shooting at a Virginia University
item.summary: On Thursday in the United States, a man opened fire at a synagogue in Michigan and was shot dead.In a separate incident, the FBI described a shooting at a university in Virginia as “terrorist” in nature; one person was killed.
